_comment: Shared set registry: read by build-price-index.py, audit-price-mapping.py and tcg-app.js. anchorNames pin the Cardmarket expansion by fingerprint; expectedProducts disambiguates when several expansions carry the same card names (Base Set 4169 has one product per card, while 1523 splits 1st Edition / Shadowless / Unlimited across 211 products and cannot be paired against a card API that models only one printing).

sets.label: Base Set
sets.pricingCaveat: Cardmarket lists Base Set under two expansions. This tracker uses 4169, which carries exactly one product per card. The other, 1523, splits 1st Edition / Shadowless / Unlimited across 211 products and cannot be paired against a card API that models one printing per card. So these are 4169's prices, not 1st Edition.

sets.label: Jungle
sets.pricingCaveat: Cardmarket does not split 1st Edition from Unlimited in this expansion, so every price here is for a single unidentified printing.
